reason: Both are engineered, project-driven industrial thermal and fluid-transport manufacturers. Both sell to industrial and energy customers and add engineering and technical services. The overlap is in the adjacent areas of pre-insulated tubing bundles versus pre-insulated pipe, and in energy and industrial end markets. Perma-Pipe's district energy and mining focus has no counterpart at Thermon. I found no cited evidence that Perma-Pipe's site sells heat tracing, so the overlap is partial on both product and customers.
